why: Witnessed pauses + inconclusive study + drowsy drive + split nights predate tirzepatide. Drug is an aggravator.

actions.text: If you are fighting sleep, do not drive.
actions.done_when: You did not drive through a 4-8/10 drowsy window.

actions.text: Move the one meal off 22:00. Put protein in it.
actions.done_when: Dinner finished before deep-work end at least 4 nights.

actions.text: If still on tirzepatide: message the prescriber about fatigue, nausea, stomach pain, considering stop. Do not change the dose yourself.
actions.done_when: Message sent, or you already stopped and logged it.

optional_helpers: Deep work 18:00-22:00 can stay. Dim/warm display after. No phone in bed.
Same morning wake. Morning outdoor light.

safety.drowsy_drive: Do not drive while fighting sleep.
